A convincing small retail folded PAPERBOARD CARTON for the fictional manufacturer DOBAJ, flavor VANILLA. Single closed carton only, centered with at least 12 percent empty transparent margin on every edge. Three-quarter product view, showing a broad front face, a narrow RIGHT side and a modest visible top. Physical proportions: front width 70, height 95, depth 19; a shallow rectangular carton, definitely folded printed paperboard rather than a tin, casket, pouch or gift box. Subtle folded edges, a thin flush top flap seam, fine matte paper grain, coherent perspective, soft warm light from upper left, realistic edge thickness and gentle contact shading. No separate cap or lid and no protrusion. NO green leaves, NO grass, NO vines, NO foliage, NO all-over plant pattern, NO ornamental leaf corners or botanical frame. No loose ingredient outside the carton. Output just this single isolated original carton, no comparison panel, no mockup canvas, no checkerboard pattern, no labels outside the product.
